transcript: Okay so today was the YC hackathon. Got to the office at like nine, the whole team crammed around one table by the window, way too many Red Bulls. Danny and I argued about the database for twenty minutes. Around sunset we finally got the first world to render and everybody screamed. Ate cold pizza on the floor.

spec.moment: The team celebrating around their laptop at sunset as the first 3D world finally renders.

elements.name: laptop
elements.look: an open silver laptop glowing brightly with a vibrant colorful miniature world on screen

elements.name: work table
elements.look: a cluttered wooden desk strewn with tangled cables, notebooks, and slim silver energy-drink cans

elements.name: office window
elements.look: a tall gridded office window frame at the back catching warm amber sunset light

elements.name: pizza box
elements.look: an open cardboard pizza box sitting on the carpet with a couple of cold leftover slices

elements.name: team
elements.look: three small figures in dark hoodies and tees, leaning in and throwing their hands up in cheer

spec.scene: On a square patch of charcoal office carpet, a cluttered wooden work table sits at the center. Three small figures in dark hoodies raise their arms in excitement around an open silver laptop that glows with bright blue and green shapes. Slim silver energy-drink cans and coiled black cables crowd the tabletop. In front, on the floor, rests an open cardboard pizza box with leftover slices. At the back edge, a tall gridded windowpane glows with rich amber sunset light.
spec.title: First World Rendered
spec.caption: At sunset the first render worked and we all lost our minds.
